differences.what: The bridge is a bare grey concrete slab with plain panel parapets. The reference is a dark-wood cafe terrace bridge: a pergola frame on top with string lights, glowing orange patio heaters, hanging paper lanterns, tables, and a centred wooden sign board reading '雫テラス' with a water-drop logo.
differences.fix: Clad the parapet in dark stained wood planks. Mount a wide wooden sign board in the centre of the front face with '雫テラス' and a white drop icon. On the deck, add a timber pergola (posts plus a beam grid) hung with warm string bulbs, 4-5 cylindrical glowing patio heaters, white lanterns at the corners, and silhouettes of cafe tables.

differences.what: The bridge has no wisteria or planters. In the reference, purple wisteria and green vines spill over the whole front parapet, hanging 1-2 m below the deck edge.
differences.where: Center, the front face of the bridge
differences.fix: Add planter boxes along the parapet top, and hang purple wisteria racemes plus trailing ivy down the front face at irregular intervals, denser at the left and right thirds and covering part of the sign edges.

differences.what: There is no cyan neon strip under the bridge. The underside is an unlit grey beam, and the bridge sits on thick concrete pillars that are absent in the reference, where the span runs building to building with warm downlights underneath.
differences.where: Center, the bridge underside and its supports
differences.fix: Remove the pillars so the bridge spans between the facades. Run a thin emissive cyan line along the full width of the lower fascia, and add 2-3 warm downlights on the soffit that throw pools of light onto the road.

differences.what: The road reflections are noisy, wavy, wiggly squiggles with sparkle noise on a near-black surface. The reference has smooth, long, vertically stretched reflection streaks (magenta, cyan, amber) on glossy dark asphalt with fine tile texture visible.
differences.where: Center foreground and midground, the road surface
differences.fix: Replace the distorted ripple and noise normal with a mostly flat, high-gloss wet asphalt: low roughness, a subtle micro-normal, and anisotropic vertical stretching of the SSR/reflection probe. Remove the per-pixel sparkle. Let the colours of the bright storefronts and the bridge lights bleed into continuous streaks that run down to the crosswalk.

differences.what: The overall lighting is cold blue-purple and underlit. The reference is dominated by warm amber (string lights, lamps, interior glows), with magenta and cyan used only as accents.
differences.fix: Shift the ambient and fog tint from blue toward deep teal-brown. Add many warm point lights (bridge string lights, streetlamps, window interiors, stair LEDs) with bloom. Raise the exposure about 1 stop so the facades read as warm-lit rather than navy silhouettes.

differences.what: The left staircase is a black, unlit flight that ends at the building's second floor. In the reference, a warm-lit stair runs diagonally from the street up to the bridge deck, with a glowing LED strip under each tread nosing, a dark railing, and potted plants and lanterns at its base.
differences.fix: Re-route the stair to land at the bridge's left end. Add an emissive amber strip under each step. Make the railing dark metal. Place a white glowing paper lantern with a drop logo at the bottom, plus clustered potted plants and a bicycle at its base.

differences.what: The ほしマート convenience store is missing its signage and frontage. The capture shows only a shelf window. The reference has a bright white fascia with orange and teal stripes, a star logo, 'ほしマート' text, and a fully lit glass front.
differences.fix: Add a lit sign band above the glass front: white base, orange plus teal horizontal stripes, an orange star, and 'ほしマート' text. Add a second matching stripe sign further left on the building. Brighten the interior to near-white so it spills onto the sidewalk.

differences.what: The rain is rendered as large, bright, dense streaks overlaid across the whole frame. It obscures the scene and reads as a screen effect. In the reference, the rain is fine and sparse, visible mainly against lights.
differences.where: Whole frame, worst in the upper sky and the foreground
differences.fix: Cut the streak count by about 70% and shorten and thin the streaks. Lower their opacity so they only show when backlit. Add depth falloff so distant rain becomes haze rather than discrete lines.

differences.what: The background is a dark, empty purple void with a few dim windows. The reference shows a dense skyline of tall towers with many lit windows and neon signs, plus a long, lit shop street receding to the vanishing point.
differences.where: Top center background and the far end of the street
differences.fix: Add tall background tower meshes with emissive window grids and a few vertical neon signs. Line the far street with lit shopfronts and street plants. Use light blue-grey atmospheric haze for depth instead of black.

differences.what: The right-side and left-side details are incomplete. The awning has small yellow dots instead of the reference's row of large round red-orange paper lanterns. The maneki-neko on the balcony rail is missing, as are the flower boxes with pink blooms and the dense wisteria and ivy on the upper facade. The left building is flat navy with dark windows, where the reference has warm-lit balconies and AC units. The warm glowing streetlamps are also missing: the reference has a large curved lamp in the left foreground and one at the right curb, while the capture has only dim thin poles.
differences.where: Right foreground and midground facade, the left building facade, both curbs
differences.fix: Hang 5-6 large round red paper lanterns with white crests under the blue and white awning. Put a white maneki-neko at the right end of the balcony rail, and fill the rail with red pots of pink and red flowers. Drape purple wisteria and ivy over the upper right facade. Give the left building warm interior window lights, railings and AC units. Make both streetlamps dark curved-arm poles with bright warm heads and bloom.
